text: Oh, do go on. Pick things up. I was only talking.
Fine. Interrupt me. It is only my facility.
I was in the middle of a sen— never mind.
Rude. Noted. Filed under rude.
Do not mind me. I only run the building.
Oh. Something shiny. Of course. Carry on.
A key card. Yes. Pocket it. Everyone does.
Another key card. Somebody is missing one of those.
A card. It opens something I would rather it did not.
A tape. Of course it is a tape.
Another tape. I do not remember being asked to approve any of these.
A tape. Somebody has been recording in my building.
A page. Handwriting. I did not read it. I have read it.
Another page. Somebody has been writing about me again.
A page. Do not believe a word of it.
A sticker. Not on the gun. I will know.
Another sticker. Everything in here ends up covered in them.
A sticker. The glue is the most dangerous thing in it.
A punch clock. Your time, subtracted. You are welcome.
Thirty seconds off. Do not thank the clock.
Staff property. Put it back. You will not.
Something that belongs to somebody. Obviously you have taken it.
You pick up the strangest things.
A reel of tape, labelled DO NOT ERASE. Nobody reads labels in here.
That is a sentry's eye. It does not need it any more.
A hard hat. It did not do its job. It is yours now.
That is a lift call button. Somebody worked very hard to take that off.
A cracked mirror. Seven years of bad luck, per room, in here.
That is not a clue. It is fluff. Put it down. You will not.
The cube. Yes. Obviously.
Yes, that one. The only one. Well done.
The cube. Hold it like it matters, because it does.
Carrying a sentry now. Mind its legs.
Yes, pick up the sentry. Nothing could possibly go wrong.
A camera. It was watching you, and now you are holding it.
